description: Convert between file formats. PDF to jpg or png pages, or to docx, xlsx, hwp, hwpx (rebuilt from the text layer). Images, HEIC included, to pdf (several paths become one PDF). XLSX/CSV to csv or json. HWP/HWPX to pdf, hwp, hwpx. JTD to docx or pdf. XDW/XBD to pdf. Every output is reopened and checked, and the result reports what could not be carried over.

out.description: Output path. For PDF to images this is a directory. Default: next to the source

pageSize.description: Images to pdf: fit makes each page the image size, a4 centers on A4. Default fit

pages.description: PDF to images: which pages, 1-based. Default all

path.description: Absolute path of the source file. Relative paths are refused

paths.description: Additional inputs. Only for images to pdf: all images are bundled in order, path first

sheet.description: Table export: sheet name or 0-based index. Default first

name: doc_convert
title: Convert document
